_route_conflict_resolution.question: Two research probes disagreed: one reported fao_participant_oi_{DDMMYYYY}.csv gives FII/DII/Client/Pro/Arb history to 2020; the other reported three nsccl archive candidates 404'd and that /api/fiidiiTradeReact is a one-day snapshot.
_route_conflict_resolution.resolution: BOTH ARE REAL. They are two different routes and each probe generalised from one.

measured_404.reason: a Sunday - NSE does not publish
route does not exist on this host

dated_csv_route.archive_depth: confirmed back to 2020-06-15 (917 B, 200). Not the archive floor; that was not probed.

snapshot_route.verdict: A genuine single-trading-day, no-history route. Built too, under parse_participant_snapshot, and it is the one that genuinely needs local accumulation. It is NOT a counter-example to the dated CSV route.

_route_conflict_resolution.arb_correction: There is NO 'Arb' row in the participant files. All three files that returned 200 (oi 2026-09-25, oi 2020-06-15, vol 2026-09-25) carry exactly Client, DII, FII, Pro plus a market-wide TOTAL. The original ticket's five-category claim is wrong for this route. What the feed genuinely adds over FII/DII is the Client/Pro split.

how_determined: NSE equity-index future open interest on 2026-09-25 is 488,031. At the 75-lot Nifty contract that is ~36.6M contracts, ~INR 91,500 crore notional.
Read as INR crore the same cell would be INR 4.88 trillion of open interest in one product, exceeding a normal full day's NSE derivatives turnover.
The file's per-category long and short legs each reconcile to the market-wide TOTAL, and Total Long == Total Short exactly - a rupee-denominated file has no reason to balance that precisely.
The sibling _vol file is the same order of magnitude (170,177 vs 488,031), consistent with both being counts.
participant_oi_and_vol.not_inferred_from: The title row says '(no. of contracts)'. That string is recorded but the unit was not taken on its word; the four measurements above are the basis.

how_determined: Per-row identity netValue == buyValue - sellValue holds exactly: 14035.77 - 11197.60 = 2838.17 and 12327.36 - 16021.29 = -3693.93.
Daily magnitudes (~INR 14,000 crore DII gross) are consistent with crore and not with rupees (too small) or millions (INR 140 crore is far below a real DII day).

amfi_workbook.how_determined: The workbook's own verbatim column header: 'Net Inflow (+ve)/Outflow (-ve) for the month of August 2026 (INR in crore)'. Corroborated by the two known-value controls: Grand Total +41,353.60 INR crore (Aug 2026) and +70,813.41 (May 2020).

_total_reconciliation_finding: The publisher's TOTAL row is NOT exactly the sum of its own detail rows. On the 2026-09-25 open-interest file: reported Total Long Contracts 27,533,553 vs 27,533,552 summed from the four categories (residual -1), short side +1. The 2020-06-15 file and the 2026-09-25 volume file both reconcile to 0. A 'totals must add up' assertion would fail on real upstream data; the residual is published in attrs['bfinance_total_reconciliation_residual'] instead.

participant_oi_20260927_sunday_404.trim_rule: no trim. NSE's 404 SPA error page, stored whole, so a test can prove a 404 body is recognised as a 404 and never parsed as a participant CSV. This is an HTML page with a 200-looking shape; parsing it as CSV is exactly the failure mode being guarded.
participant_oi_20260927_sunday_404.note: 2026-09-27 was a SUNDAY. NSE does not publish on a weekend, so this 404 is the expected, correct outcome - not an error. The module answers this from the local weekday check and never spends the request.
